description: This file defines the SpgrContainer class, which manages shape group containers and their child shape containers within a graphics or drawing context, providing methods to set/get parent containers, add children, and recursively retrieve contained shape objects.

classes.name: SpgrContainer
classes.description: Class representing a shape group container that can contain other groups or shape containers, with recursive retrieval of shape containers.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent shape group container.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent shape group container, if set.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child (shape container or shape group) and sets its parent.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the collection of child shape containers or groups.

methods.name: getAllSpContainers
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all shape containers within this group container.
